script_text: Pisces, Mars picks a fight with Saturn in your money zone — your wallet feels the punch. Mars in Cancer squares Saturn in Aries, igniting a volatile T-square across your 5th House of romance and 2nd House of income. Neptune, your modern ruler, sits at 1° Aries in that 2nd House, thickening the fog around financial choices. Meanwhile Jupiter at 29° Cancer squares Neptune, doubling the confusion. This cardinal square demands structure, not guesswork. Mars agitating your 5th House turns flirtation combative — don't confuse intensity for intimacy; singles attract partners who honor boundaries, not chaos. The Jupiter-Neptune square across your 5th and 2nd Houses signals a creative payday that evaporates — verify every contract clause before signing. Avoid lending cash to friends; the cosmos gifts you a sudden insight about a passive income stream you've overlooked. Follow for tomorrow's reading when Venus enters your 4th House and shifts the emotional weather.
